title: Giving up the California house before Europe
summary: Everyone expected Zutty could return to Club 47, but they left California for Europe and the owner's estate later asked them to buy the house they had been renting.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yes. And when we left Europe everybody was saying that Zuttie could come to work out there. He could go right back in Club 47.
Well when did you sell the house out there then?
It was our furniture. But they wrote to us in Europe. I liked the house so much I wanted to buy it, but the woman wouldn't sell, Mrs. (KAPLAN ?). But while we were in Europe they
contacted us through our band, the Bank of America that Mrs. (KAPLAN ?) had passed away and her daughter who had charge of the estate, contacted us in Europe to buy the house.
And you would have done I suppose .......................
